WHAT WAS ASKED — ROLE-SPECIFIC ACCOUNTS
An SDE account reports an OA with two DSA tasks and 40 MCQs, followed by technical, managerial and ETR stages. Its suggestion that graph questions are likely is the writer's opinion, not a guaranteed question distribution.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MzAxOQ

An intern account describes arrays and linked-list work in one technical interview and tree/graph problems in another, with emphasis on optimization, complexity, edge cases and changing constraints. It reports about 45 minutes per technical round.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MzAxMQ

An SDE account reports BST validation and traversals, then opening project code and implementing a small feature. This is a useful signal to prepare for demonstrating genuine project ownership, not just reciting a project description.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/Mjk5OQ

A network SWE intern describes completing one 45-60 minute technical round on DSA, OOP, OS and projects, while awaiting the second round. The account is an in-progress process, not a confirmed completed selection.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MzAzNg

QUESTION PATTERNS IN OAHELPER
124 published non-mock question records. Types: CODING: 63, MCQ: 61.
Difficulty labels: Medium: 110, Easy: 11, Hard: 3.
97/124 records have usable topic labels.
Most frequent stored topics: Array (26), Graph (23), Greedy (19), Math (18), Simulation (16), Sorting (16), Dynamic Programming (14), Hash Table (14).
A question can have several tags. These frequencies describe the uploaded corpus; they do not predict the next OA. Mock and duplicate-marked questions are excluded.
